name: weave-texture
title: Weave Texture
description: A quiet woven cloth behind a section: warp threads in `--strand-a` and weft threads in `--strand-b`, passing over and under each other in a plain weave. It is texture, not glow: nothing moves, nothing shines, and at the default strength it sits just above…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/weave-texture

Installed to `components/ui/effects/weave-texture.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/weave-texture';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/weave-texture

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
